items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Actually, Ray Bloch was there and I didn't work with him initially.

ctx.x: Most of that was with the Ray Block Orchestra?

He was the conductor when I first got there. Later, we had many other conductors. Actually, Ray Bloch was there and I didn't work with him initially. I worked with another conductor who did today Garry Moore show. But, Ray Bloch was the conductor for the Ed Sullivan show. I guess he did other things like American musical center and so forth, all the shows. The conductor that I worked under it was Erwin Cossel. He was a fine pianist. He later took a show – – I think when the Carol Burnett show moved to California,…
What was your working schedule like? Now, you are CBS staff. This is not a freelance scenario.
